notes: Recognizes many more older cards: their pictures from the card database are now downloaded properly, so cards like Furious Fists Clauncher are found on their own.
Recognizes more cards on its own: it ignores the small "Evolves from" line, and it's sure of a card when the name or number on it matches and the picture is clearly the closest.
An Open folder button on the watching bar (and in Settings) shows where your scans are.
